issues.description: input_audio_codec silently dropped from connect_kwargs for all models
issues.detail: The old code passed input_audio_codec to the SDK connect call. The new code removes it entirely from connect_kwargs with no replacement. If any model needs non-wav input, this is now broken silently. Either keep the field or state in the commit why every endpoint ignores it.

issues.description: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS default_speaker for v3-beta disagrees with its own documentation
issues.detail: The PR description and the docstring say default speaker for bulbul:v3-beta is 'aditya'. The actual TTSModelConfig sets default_speaker='shubh'. One of them is a lie. The code is the truth, the docs are wrong, or vice versa. Pick one and make them match before this lands.

issues.description: set_prompt swallows ValueError for None on unsupported models instead of being consistent
issues.detail: set_prompt raises ValueError if prompt is non-None on a model that doesn't support prompts, but silently returns if prompt is None. That's a special case. Either always raise on unsupported models, or always no-op. The current shape forces callers to know which models accept the call at all, which defeats the abstraction.

This is (1) STT v3 model support, (2) STT refactor to MODEL_CONFIGS table, (3) TTS v3 model + enums + clamping. Each is independently reviewable and bisectable. As one diff it's harder to revert any single piece if v3-beta misbehaves in production. Split it.

issues.description: Speaker enums and TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS.speakers duplicate the same list twice
issues.detail: SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums exist, and then speakers=tuple(s.value for s in SarvamTTSSpeakerV2) re-derives the same data. Fine. But get_speakers_for_model returns List[str] for unknown models by defaulting to v2 — silently. That's bad taste: an unknown model should fail loudly, not pretend to be v2.

issues.description: ModelConfig has both use_translate_endpoint and use_translate_method as separate fields
issues.detail: Two booleans that, looking at the table, always move together (saaras:v2.5 sets both True, others both False). One field would do. If they can legitimately diverge in some future model, fine — but document why. Otherwise this is two special cases where one would do.

review.summary: The refactor from substring-matching ("saaras" in model.lower()) to an explicit MODEL_CONFIGS table is good taste — it eliminates the special-case-by-string-match pattern and is the right shape. But this is three patches submitted as one (STT refactor, STT v3 support, TTS v3 support), the v3-beta default speaker disagrees between code and docs, and input_audio_codec quietly disappears from the STT connect call with no explanation. NEEDS-WORK: split the diff, fix the speaker mismatch, explain or restore input_audio_codec, and decide whether set_prompt(None) is a no-op or an error on unsupported models — don't have it be both.
